description: This file defines a utility object SplitUtils with functions to split a string into tokens based on spaces, storing the tokens in a custom LinkedList implementation.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A utility singleton object providing string splitting functionality.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens separated by spaces, returning a LinkedList of tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it passes validation.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks whether a token should be considered valid (non-empty).
